messages:
Sam W: Heads-up — onboarding FinServCo POC. They require EU-only data locality for model inputs/outputs and want KMS control. Can we confirm options? TL;DR: need region pin, subproc list, and egress path confirmation. cc @Anya V @Troy L
Anya V: Thanks. Quick answers: we have regional endpoints (eu-west1, eu-west2). For strict locality we recommend Dedicated or Private, but hosted can be configured for many controls. Which mode are they starting with?
Sam W: They're starting hosted but open to Dedicated if the SLA/pricing makes sense. Primary asks: (1) Can requests and logs remain in EU? (2) KMS — customer-managed key vs Redwood KMS in EU HSM? (3) Any subprocessors outside EU touching payloads? (4) pricing delta for EU-only routing/pinning?
Anya V: (1) Hosted keeps compute in chosen region; logs/telemetry default to our telemetry pipeline (US). For enterprise we can enable EU-only telemetry retention. (2) We support customer-managed keys (GCP KMS, AWS KMS) — need key resource and region. (3) Short answer: compute and storage in EU, but a few observability vendors are global. @Troy L to confirm whether any subprocessors process payloads outside EU. (4) Pricing: region-pin + KMS + retention → rough +20-35% on token/storage costs; will get exact numeric quote.
Troy L: Re: subprocessors — data plane for eu-west* runs in-region. Telemetry collector runs in EU but longer-term analytics/alerting may replicate some metadata outside EU for ops. We can opt-out per-tenant for this POC. No model weights or raw payloads leave region unless we trigger a cross-region fallback. I'll document the exception paths.
Marie I: For Dedicated, ops can provision a dedicated GPU pool in eu-west-1 and enforce egress controls; ops will need a signed addendum. For hosted, we can apply a tenant-level geo-routing policy. Example config snippet: ```json
{"tenant_id":"finservco","route_policy":"prefer_region:eu-west-1","kms":"customer:projects/finservco-kms"}
```
Kevin S: Customer wants ETA — POC kickoff next Monday. What's the minimal configuration to satisfy legal while keeping hosted? They'd prefer not to move to Dedicated yet.
Anya V: Minimal safe path: hosted + EU telemetry opt-out + customer-managed KMS (EU region) + tenant region pin. We'll need Legal & Security signoff and a short SCP (subprocessor control plan) attached to the SOW. I can draft steps and ballpark costs today.
Troy L: I'll prepare a short security note for the questionnaire: confirm data-at-rest/in-transit stays in EU, KMS control with CMK, subprocessors list with EU-only flag, and fallback policy. Also include a customer checkbox for "allow fallback to other region" they must explicitly opt-in to.
Sam W: Perfect. Can someone paste link to subprocessor inventory and quick cost delta for EU pinning? I'll share with the customer's legal ops.
Anya V: Subproc inventory (internal): https://company-docs.internal/subprocessors.csv — public summary available in the SOC2 pack. Cost delta rough numbers: Hosted baseline ~0.012/token → EU-pin estimate ~0.015-0.017/token; Dedicated will need formal quote. I'll attach a short breakdown.
deploy-bot: New region policy template `eu-tenant-pin-v1` created by @Anya V — ID rp_2028_eu. See /configs/policies
Kevin S: Thanks. If you can drop the security note and cost ballpark by EOD I can loop Legal and schedule the kickoff.
Anya V: On it. @Troy L I'll DM you for the exact subprocessors list and any redlines.
Troy L: Seen. Adding to my queue, will send draft by 17:00 CET. :thumbsup:
Sam W: Great — thanks team :pray:
